code.description: Stable ErrorCode name (for example PAGE_TOKEN_INVALID), or the status name (for example INVALID_ARGUMENT or RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED) when no ErrorCode applies.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation; not stable, do not parse it.

title.description: Short summary: the HTTP status text.

type.description: URI identifying the problem type: https://polyester.dev/problems/ followed by code in lowercase, with hyphens for underscores, for example https://polyester.dev/problems/page-token-invalid for PAGE_TOKEN_INVALID.

completedAt.description: When the QuickSwap completed: its destination payout was final.

deposits.description: The credited deposits that funded the QuickSwap, oldest first: one in practice.

txHash.description: Source-network transaction that sent the deposit, in the network's canonical text form, as GetQuickSwap reports it in Deposit.tx_hash.

destinationAmount.description: Amount delivered to the destination, in destination token units, after the withdrawal network fee.

decimals.description: Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. ApiKeyIdAuth.description: ID of the API key that signs the request. An API-key request sends it with X-API-TIMESTAMP and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyIdAuth.name: X-API-KEY-ID

ApiKeySignatureAuth.description: Ed25519 signature of the request, made with the API key's private key and encoded as hex or base64. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-TIMESTAMP.
ApiKeySignatureAuth.name: X-API-SIGNATURE

ApiKeyTimestampAuth.description: Time the request was signed, in Unix milliseconds. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyTimestampAuth.name: X-API-TIMESTAMP

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

info.description:
Public trading API for market makers and integrators.
Connect RPC over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with JSON and Protobuf.
info.title: Polyester API

get.description: List completed QuickSwaps of every broker, newest first, by source and destination assets and networks and by source USD value.

parameters.description: Only QuickSwaps to one of these assets, on any of their networks, as asset ledger IDs, at most 20: repeat the parameter.
parameters.name: destinationAssetId

parameters.description: Only QuickSwaps to one of these destination assets and networks, as zipped asset IDs, at most 20: repeat the parameter.
parameters.name: destinationZippedAssetId

parameters.description: Maximum number of QuickSwaps to return; 0 means 50, at most 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only QuickSwaps whose sourceValueUsd is below this, on the same grid as minSourceValueUsd; above minSourceValueUsd when both are given, and so not 0 alone. Omit it for no upper bound. 1000000000000000000000 is $1,000.
parameters.name: maxSourceValueUsd

parameters.description: Only QuickSwaps whose sourceValueUsd is at least this, as base units of 18 decimals (sourceValueUsd.baseUnits): 0, or 1, 2 or 5 times a power of ten dollars from $1 to $1,000,000,000, so 1, 2 or 5 followed by 18 to 26 zeros, or 1 followed by 27 zeros; 100000000000000000000 is $100. Omit it for no lower bound. With a USD bound the list holds only QuickSwaps completed at least 5 minutes before it is read.
parameters.name: minSourceValueUsd

parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous nextPageToken, exclusive, bound to the filters, the networks their asset IDs covered and the newest-first order. If a network was added to or removed from one of the asset IDs since the first page, it is PAGE_TOKEN_INVALID: request the first page again. Omit for the first page.
parameters.name: pageToken

parameters.description: Only QuickSwaps from one of these assets, on any of their networks, as asset ledger IDs, at most 20: repeat the parameter.
parameters.name: sourceAssetId

parameters.description: Only QuickSwaps from one of these source assets and networks, as zipped asset IDs, at most 20: repeat the parameter (?sourceZippedAssetId=3&sourceZippedAssetId=12).
parameters.name: sourceZippedAssetId

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request, a USD bound off the grid, filters that select more than 400 routes or routes times USD value steps, or a maxSourceValueUsd not above minSourceValueUsd; PAGE_TOKEN_INVALID: a pageToken that is malformed, from other filters, or from before a change of the networks the asset IDs cover (request the first page again).

429.description: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: the client address exceeded its request rate; retry after the Retry-After header's seconds.

500.description: INTERNAL: an internal error; retry the same request.

503.description: UNAVAILABLE or DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: retry the same request.

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: Get one completed QuickSwap of any broker by its swap ID.

parameters.description: Public QuickSwap identifier, as a decimal string.
parameters.name: swap_id

404.description: SWAP_NOT_FOUND: no completed QuickSwap has this swap ID: none has it, it is 0 or not a decimal unsigned 64-bit integer, or the QuickSwap has not completed, whatever its status. Every such answer is the same.

429.description: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: the client address exceeded its request rate; retry after the Retry-After header's seconds.

500.description: INTERNAL: an internal error; retry the same request.

503.description: UNAVAILABLE or DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: retry the same request.

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: Get totals, a time series and per-route totals of completed QuickSwaps of every broker over a window.

parameters.description: The window: the last 24 hours in hourly buckets, the last 7, 30 or 90 days in daily buckets, or the last 26 weeks in weekly buckets, each ending at the end of the current bucket.
parameters.name: window

400.description: INVALID_ARGUMENT: no window, or an unknown one.

429.description: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: the client address exceeded its request rate; retry after the Retry-After header's seconds.

500.description: STATS_INCOMPLETE: a completed QuickSwap in the window lacks its deposited or delivered amount (swapId names it); INTERNAL: an internal error.

503.description: UNAVAILABLE or DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: retry the same request.

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.
